title: Implement a queue with stacks
statementMd:
Simulate a queue with operations `['push', x]`, `['pop']` (returns and removes the front), `['peek']` (returns the front) and `['empty']` (returns a bool). Return the results of pop, peek and empty in order.

**Example:** `ops_queue([["push", 1], ["push", 2], ["peek"], ["pop"], ["empty"]])` returns `[1, 1, false]`.
